content.comment_body: Hello everyone, I purchased a [product_name] with article number [article_no]. The product description indicated that programming software would be included on a micro SD card. However, I didn't find it in the package or inserted in the device. Is it standard for the engineering software to come on an SD card, or have I misunderstood something?

The programming software used to create programs isn't limited to an SD card. While you can store user programs on the SD card, it's not strictly necessary since the device can store them internally in flash memory.

My point is: where is the engineering software itself? It's not available for download (only the demo version is), it wasn't included on an SD card as the description suggested, and there wasn't a CD with it either.

On the [company_name] website, only upgrades or demo versions of the [product_name] software can be downloaded, not the full version. The complete version is only available on CD or DVD. Here are the order numbers: [product_name] single license [article_no], [product_name] upgrade [article_no].

If you already have a full version of [product_name] (regardless of version), you can download a free upgrade from [company_name]'s website. Otherwise, you'll need to purchase the full version from a local dealer.
But why does the product description at the link below say: "MICRO SD CARD FOR [product_name] V8 OR HIGHER PREVIOUS PROJECT USABLE"? [url]
You might be reading that statement out of context. It's actually referring to data logging. Here’s the full passage.
Oh, I see now—there were no commas in the sentence, which caused my confusion. Thanks a lot!

Since I've already purchased two units with article number [article_no], I can confirm: the [product_name] V8 software isn't free here. However, since I already had a previous version, I was able to get a free upgrade from [company_name].
This forum is lucky to have you. Your responses are always quick and accurate. Thank you again.
And thank you for the kind words.

analysis.insight_summary: The user misunderstood the product listing, assuming the engineering software would come with the hardware on a micro SD card. Actually, only user programs or data are handled via the SD card, and the full version of the software must be purchased separately on CD/DVD—only demos or upgrades are downloadable. The confusion arose from unclear product description wording related to how the software is supplied and used.
analysis.user_expectations: The user expected the complete engineering software to be physically included with the hardware or on a micro SD card, as seemed implied in the product description. They also hoped to easily access a full version for download or within the box, rather than just receiving a demo or requiring an upgrade.
